resources.string:
Available Commands:
/help - Display help information
/getinfo - Get system information
/log - Output the last 10 log records
/sendsms1 - Send SMS using SIM slot 1\n/sendsms2 - Send SMS using SIM slot 2
"/sendussd1 - Send USSD request using SIM slot 1\n/sendussd2 - Send USSD request using SIM slot 2"
/listsms inbox - List inbox messages\n/listsms sent - List sent messages
